title: Structured Outputs and Tool Contracts

control.text:
The risk object is used to track the risk of a KV cache configuration. The risk object contains the following fields:

- `name`: The name of the risk.
- `description`: A description of the risk.
- `severity`: The severity of the risk.
- `impact`: The impact of the risk.
- `risk_level`: The risk level of the risk.
- `risk_score`:

analysis: Structured success/JSON/schema=True/True/True; unconstrained JSON parsed=False. Independent semantic/authorization validation remains required.
conclusion: Constrained decoding can establish syntax/schema form; application meaning and tool safety remain independent responsibilities.
